name: code-buddy
description: Code Buddy (the agent), lm-resizer (the context filter) and Code Explorer (the codebase knowledge graph) for Claude Code.

plugins.name: code-buddy
plugins.description: Skill to operate the buddy CLI correctly (headless, provider pinning, permissions, verify loop) + read-only MCP server.

plugins.name: lm-resizer
plugins.description: Filter noisy command output before it reaches the model; raw output stays recoverable. Skill + MCP server.

plugins.name: code-explorer
plugins.description: Map the codebase first: symbols, callers, impact/blast radius, hotspots over a pre-indexed knowledge graph. Skill + MCP server.
